question:
You are helping Nour, who runs a furniture workshop near Kenitra. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The workshop makes stools, desks and frames.
Each of the stools needs 1 units of wood, 1 machine hours, and earns a profit of 38 dollars.
Each of the desks needs 3 units of wood, 6 machine hours, and earns a profit of 107 dollars.
Salma, who manages the site, has 19 years of experience.
The parking lot has 56 spaces, 6 of them reserved for visitors.
Office rent is 6,700 dollars per month, paid whatever the plan.
Each of the frames needs 2 units of wood, 9 machine hours, and earns a profit of 47 dollars.
This week the workshop has 27 units of wood and 126 machine hours available.
A competitor opened a new site in Rabat 10 months ago.
Everything produced will be sold, and only whole units can be made.
How many of each product should be made to maximise total profit?
answer_keys: The maximum total profit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total profit in dollars
independent_check: brute force over every production plan
